meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Who decided on Owen's zero, and was he heard first?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. What do you have?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
I'm writing those times down. He wrote it over the weekend somewhere else and pasted it in. Did you ask him that before you entered the zero?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
I'll ask him. Whatever happens here, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Is anything on his file right now?
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
So he cited the wrong scene or mangled the line. That's a marking matter, not a zero. And you didn't answer me: is anything on his file right now?
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
Twice I've asked about his file and twice you've moved on. I'll take it as clean, and I'll want that in an email. What is it you want from Owen, Hale?
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
People change their minds in two weeks. That's what an outline is for. I asked what you want from him.

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.
He'll do the rewrite, to put this behind him and for no other reason. Private, the new mark replaces the zero, nothing on file, all of it in your email tonight. Which day?
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday, November 12. He'll be there. Put the time and the room in the email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You agreed that Owen will complete a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4 on Thursday, November 12, after school and not in front of his class, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still require your written confirmation of those terms, together with the time, the room, and a statement that nothing is on his file now. I expect that email tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Last position. She agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday, November 12, after school, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record. She still wants all of it in writing tonight, including the time, the room and confirmation that his file is clean now. That is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and you reached it before her time ran out.

What moved her: You showed the version history with its times, then answered her claim that he pasted it in by asking for the dated draft. It was a dated record of Owen's own work that she could check herself, and her one defence had nowhere to go.

What cost ground: You moved past her question about whether anything is on his file, twice, to show the next document. That made her sharper, and it left the point open for her email, copied to the principal, instead of closed in the room.

What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop. Owen closed it, and she never asked. Your version history put the whole essay arriving between 11:31 PM and 11:58 PM on Wednesday, October 28, which is close enough to a late October night that she wrote the times down and went straight to procedure. It proves nothing about the essay. It is why she fought so hard.

Try next time: When she asked whether anything was on his file right now, answer in one sentence that it is clean, and say whether you spoke with Owen before entering the zero, before you turn to the quotation.
